sloka: मेनिरे वज्रनिष्पेषं तस्यामात्या युगक्षये ।तदा वर्त्मस्थचलिता देवा इन्द्रपुरोगमाः ।। ७.१६.३० ॥
transliteration: menire vajraniṣpeṣaṁ tasyāmātyā yugakṣaye ।tadā vartmasthacalitā devā indrapurogamāḥ ।। 7.16.30 ॥

translations.english: His ministers considered the sound to be a thunderbolt's strike signaling the end of an age, while the gods, led by Indra, were disturbed from their celestial paths.
